notes: Environmental hazards (designer request, 2026-10-12). Book (Core p.327): a lingering hazard covers an area and inflicts an Injury on anyone in it at the start of each round they remain; its severity starts at 1 (Hazard Severity table). An Injury from a hazard is Avoided like any other (Book p.291: Stress for a main or supporting character, Threat for a notable NPC, never for a minor NPC).

PROTOTYPE RULES (designer decisions, 2026-10-12): a hazard covers tiles, not zones. In combat it acts at the start of each round; in exploration one hazard round passes every roundSeconds of world time. Each character on a hazard tile suffers one Injury per round (the most severe hazard they stand in). Smoke and Toxic Gas tiles at thickIntensity or more block line of sight and line of fire; thinner ones give cover.

PLACEHOLDER NUMBERS (designer: use placeholders, tune later): severity, spreadChance, dissipateChance and migrateChance (percent per tile per round), damagesObjects (Structure a destructible next to the tile loses each round, ignoring Resistance) and every neutralize task.

Spreading: each tile at intensity 2 or more may spread to one open orthogonal neighbour (not a solid tile) at one less intensity. Dissipating: each tile may lose 1 intensity; at 0 it is gone. Migrating: a thick tile may move its intensity onto an empty neighbour (the patch shifts). Explosion leftover footprints are a Euclidean circle with a jittered rim (not a filled square).

One type per tile (Prototype, designer 2026-10-15): only one hazard type occupies a tile; higher severity wins. Fire and plasmaFire leave a permanent walkable scorched floor scar (scarTile) for the mission.

neutralize: the Challenge action that puts the whole hazard out, offered on the hazard's ring through the usual challenge roll (world/EnvironmentalHazard.js); hazards are never challenge objects in the scenario (docs/performance.md). Any authored challenge outcome can also put one out with the neutralizeHazard effect.

layer (implementation detail): floor and air hazards both sort in the depth layer among the blocks and figures (floor just above the block on its tile, air above that), so a wall or crate in front hides them and fire in front of a crate sits on top of it.
movement (PROTOTYPE, placeholder, designer request 2026-10-14 to approve): slow: a tile costs double movement in combat and halves walking speed in exploration.

A region on the map may set duration (hazard rounds it lasts; empty: until it dissipates), spread (false: never spreads), active (false: placed but not yet acting) and neutralizable (false: no Neutralize task).

AFFLICTION AFTER LEAVE (Prototype, designer 2026-10-15): Book lingering hazards stop hurting when you leave the tile. Prototype: after a damaging hazard Injury, the character keeps an affliction for baseAfflictionRounds hazard rounds (shortened by Fitness, floor 1), which keeps dealing that Injury each round off the tile. Suits with hazardImmunity ignore matching types entirely.
